name: Glucosamine
short: As safe as placebo for adverse reactions in a review of 20 trials. Reports suggest it may raise INR in people on warfarin; evidence on blood glucose effects is mixed.
text: In a systematic review of 20 randomised trials with 2570 patients, glucosamine was as safe as placebo in terms of the number of people reporting adverse reactions. A case report with a review of spontaneous reports to US and WHO adverse-event databases suggests that glucosamine taken with warfarin may lead to an increased INR (a measure of blood clotting time); the authors advised that people on warfarin tell their health care provider if they take glucosamine. A systematic review of 11 studies found mixed evidence on whether glucosamine affects glucose metabolism, with effects more likely to be detected in studies of people who had impaired glucose tolerance or insulin resistance at baseline.
